Customized Polaroids

Authentic vintage film frames, custom timestamping, song lyrics, or personal moments printed on rigid cardstock. Includes option for handwritten typography or digital Spotify codes.

  • True 1:1 square instant film proportion with classic wide chin
  • Custom dates, coordinates, or song lines printed at base
  • Anti-smudge matte finish with authentic paper rigidity

[ Studio Heritage ] Est. 2024

A little about
MAKINGZZZ.

MAKINGZZZ started with a simple idea — the things you love deserve a place on your walls.

We believe posters are more than just prints. They’re expressions of personality, memories, interests and everything that makes you, YOU.

From iconic movie characters and unforgettable celebrities to meaningful quotes and personal memories, we bring your favourite visuals closer to you.

And if you have something unique in mind, we’re here to make it happen. Whether it’s a customized poster or a personalized polaroid, we make creativity personal.

Your space tells your story. Let us help you tell it.

 100% Indie Studio • Curated for real rooms • Chennai & Pan-India shipping
